scope: Targeted primary-label review of 22 retained full-view label/name findings and two semantic repairs. Actual Chrome accessibility names are associated with the reviewed DOM nodes. Raw axe results remain preserved. This is not speech-recognition testing, a universal all-frame claim or full-catalog accessibility acceptance.

changes.change: Full accessible names include Return whenever the back is painted. The complete note is an accessible description with accurate pin/Escape instructions. Note copy is cached once without frame-time layout reads; ARIA writes occur only when values change.
Full accessible name includes Target link and the selected satellite ID. The actual currently painted readout is exposed as the accessible description.

verification.nativeScope: Independent original/current paused native definitions. Exact geometry, DOM, computed styles and PNG bytes after a priming readback. GPU disabled for CSS/pixel comparison only; not default-GPU or timing acceptance.

nativeVisibility.scope: Native Chrome hidden tabs. Every selected component mounts in each selected mode/motion, then freezes its real runtime clock, probe callbacks, DOM, Canvas/WebGL calls, inspection state and existing animation times while the browser reports a trusted hidden event. Foreground and caller ownership are tested independently. This does not establish input-specific hidden intent, offscreen behavior, pixel fidelity, motion recipes, accessibility or frame rate.

verification.rawAxeScope: Initial rendered component and shared Dock only; current Stage styles. Does not establish keyboard/touch behavior, screen-reader quality, focus clipping, photographic contrast, hidden states or motion/performance acceptance.
